intro: Color your own cute animal friends with colorful crayons!
description:
A colorful fairytale world that comes to life at your fingertips!
Complete your own special sketchbook with cute friends!

<Crayon Friends> is a healing coloring simulation game where anyone can freely fill in cute characters with their own colors, without complicated rules or stress.

Rabbits, bears, birds, cool dinosaurs and even cute astronauts! A variety of illustrations and rich crayon colors are available.  Easily open your own atelier anytime, anywhere with intuitive touch operation optimized for.

■ Special fun elements unique to <Crayon Friends>

Colorful character lineup: From forest animals to imaginary monsters and dinosaurs, there are many cute characters that will catch the eyes of users.

Challenge and Medal System: You can feel a unique sense of accomplishment by earning a wonderful medal for each uniquely completed painting.

Camera function to leave memories: Take a picture of the work you worked hard to complete with a camera and store it nicely in your sketchbook album.

Equipped with fun minigames: “Who will be the character I completed?” After you finish coloring, an intuitive and exciting quiz game unfolds where you have to find the character you designed yourself!

Perfect healing play environment: Helps develop children's creativity and relieve adults' stress in warm sounds, without time limits or competition elements.
